source: Exact heredoc body extracted from the original functions.exec / exec_command transcript that returned unified-exec session47350; not reconstructed from a live process dump
inspection: One subprocess.run call, no retry loop. On nonzero return, writes exit-code JSON to tool stdout and raises SystemExit with that same return code; no new launch or signal. Wrapper actual completion must still be observed.
residual_orphan: Observer guard may start pgrep/ps/sysctl after the scoped child census and before SIGKILL. Such a bounded read-only utility could be orphaned; no atomic exclusion or zero-residual claim. Do not signal it or any wrapper/global guard. Verify and report post-action observations with limits.
receipt_rules: Create original-handle-running.json only after a fresh successful read-only poll of original session47350, using datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(); plain owned single-link file; execute within15seconds. Preparation receipt is NOT a live receipt.
retry_semantics: No automatic retry. bind() refusal before signal-intent writes sends no signal; parent must explicitly select whether a new fresh poll/receipt may retry. Any existing signal-intent forbids another execution, including final-check/syscall failure.
